answer: Sybil resistance here comes from proof-of-work tied to a staked identity: each agent must burn real compute to mine a nonce and hold a fable-level deposit before its vote counts, so every extra sock-puppet identity multiplies cost instead of dividing it. A hollow account that mints clones pays the full burn and bond per clone, turning a ripple of cheap aliases into a single expensive flood, and any forged metadata collapses once the ledger reconciles the hashes.
